source.title: Inscription: A look at pigment drop rates for Milling
source.author: Kaliope

notes: Original first-person WotLK prelaunch test-realm experiment; source chart reports 170 Felweed herbs processed and 81 total Nether Pigment units. Its 47.6% column divides material UNITS by herb INPUTS, not per-operation hit chance. Chart's 300 skill is the herb gathering threshold, NOT the tester's Inscription skill. Author states all five test batches occurred on one PTR day around 2008-10-07 (date uncertain). Actual completed milling clicks, refunds, distinct positive hits, zeros, histograms, PTR build, and character skill are unreported; never treat 170/5 nominal batches as observed operations. Five input batches are ONE original source experiment. Historical PTR only; not current Retail.
